scope: Actual checked-source, single-initializer Boolean/NIL acyclic programs execute fresh zero-capture Closure, fixed CallK and one-produced Ret through the standalone owned core. This is trusted build-artifact execution, independent of native raw persistence admission.

contracts.frontend: One checked functiongraph frontend and complete guest graphs. graphcopies extracts the existing parallel-copy algorithm; frozen legacygraph is unchanged. Immutable borrowed checked CST/type objects and build-source filesystem are trusted.
contracts.derivation: Complete catalog only; exactly one initializer, Boolean/NIL scalar kinds, zero captures, acyclic calls, fixed arguments/parameters <=63, wanted1. Absent returns are refused even in unused catalog functions; persistent absent-versus-NIL semantics remain intact. CallK base precedes arguments/results and result uses base+1. Live SSA, call staging and parallel-copy scratch fit the checked physical slot cap.
contracts.authority: Fixed reviewed buildGuest/buildGuestAudit source sets and retained original owners/layouts. Private issued executable/source/session/graph/Result/Code identities survive publication and exact linking; copied or mutated scopes, executable, graphs, context, allocator mode and code refuse.
contracts.slots: Only original sealed guest handler graphs may use existing v/uint64/8-byte mechanical slot transport after final State/frame/window/PC verification. No tagged arithmetic, managed-call, GC or unissued legacy-route admission.
contracts.entry: Checked Context layout retains SIZE128. All mapped Binding extents and dispatch offsets are bounded/disjoint before publication. World is retained and never reset; failed Storage is consumed. Original root/serial live outside the logical pool and active frame cache.
contracts.calls: Charge/cancel precede lookup/reservation. Runtime instance owner/target/signature and scalar arguments match retained callsites; prepare/publish identities and exact success edges bind reacquisition. Result is selected and checked before retirement. finishRoot success and mandatory complete govern output; no output on failure.
contracts.cleanup: Prepared child abort precedes deepest-first active-child unwind and root retirement, with no additional work-budget checks. Actual RootControl state/frame/serial authenticate cleanup before mutation; stale completion cannot mutate a newer activation.
contracts.audits: Supplemental fixed leaves execute only after independent primary programs. Primary linked words/dispatch/guest streams remain exact prefixes. Audit statuses do not substitute for primary values; separate helper/snapshot extents and ABI canaries apply.

earlierFocused.scope: Earlier source component evidence, not final whole-source acceptance. Final native source and narrow compiler changes are bound below; parent owns combined shared/fixpoint after Boolean branch composition.

native.auditScratch: Separate derived test-only audit helper/snapshot storage; exact high-water and extent retained per audit. Production scratch default remains65536.
